effect_description_eng:
This card is also treated as [Sparrowmon] for a DigiXros.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait among them to the hand. Trash the rest.
[On Deletion] Place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.).
